hooks.command: HOOK_DATA=$(cat 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'); printf '{"event":"idle_prompt","sessionId":"%s","data":%s}' "$CODEMAN_SESSION_ID" "$HOOK_DATA" | curl -sk -X POST "$CODEMAN_API_URL/api/hook-event" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-Codeman-Hook-Secret: $(cat "$CODEMAN_HOOK_SECRET_FILE" 2>/dev/null)" --data @- 2>/dev/null || true
